test_title: PYST 25: SSC MTS - English (Held on: 14 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select ‘No improvement required’.**

He sounded like he __were to going__ cry.
solution:
The correct answer is: **was going to**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Replace "**were to going**" with "**was going to**" in order to correct the sentence.
